correctness.rationale: For b,h>=1 every colored vertex type is exactly its color together with its child-type set; all such sets of cardinality at most b are realizable by disjoint child-subtree valuations. Recursive finite modal characteristic formulas isolate every type, and height tests separate heights. Every Boolean subset of types is definable and distinct under some valuation, proving precisely 2^E operations. Polynomial degree n and coefficient (b!)^(-(n-1)/b) are derived by induction, and strict monotonicity of geometric means recovers b; n recovers h. No unproved use of finite tests: 51 exhaustive type checks, 3 direct term closures and 28 coefficient checks independently corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-arity operation counts form a natural algebraic invariant of a finite Boolean modal algebra. Showing that its degree and leading coefficient recover the complete two-parameter frame provides a structurally motivated inverse result, including distinction of equal-size frames (two different 31-vertex complete trees). This is a complete classification on a natural family, not an arbitrary finite computation or a bare textbook deduction.
